A '''Dug debris loader''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] vehicle that served in [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare's]] armed forces during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Dug_debris_loader.png|thumb|left|200px|Debris loaders at work]]
The Dug debris loader had a large crane that could pick up debris and ammunition. An enclosed cockpit was located at the front of the vehicle for the driver/crane operator.<ref name="TZB-EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode218.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

==History==
They were used at the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], where the debris loaders supplied the [[Dug rail gun/Legends|Dug rail guns]] with ammunition. When the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] climbed out of the sinkhole created by the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], it destroyed several of these units.<ref name="TZB" />
